sources.entry: Django-CRM - Analytical CRM with tasks management, email marketing and many more. Django CRM is built for individual use, businesses of any size or freelancers and is designed to provide easy customization and quick development. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python

summary.one_liner: Django-CRM is a free, self-hosted, Python/Django customer relationship management system that bundles CRM records, task and project management, email client and marketing, and analytics, built on the Django Admin interface.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a CRM covering requests, leads, companies and contacts, deals, products and payments, with over 80 interconnected models. A task management module adds tasks, subtasks, projects, internal chat, files, reminders, and office memos that can be converted into tasks. An analytics app provides sales funnel analysis, income summary reports, lead source analytics, and a requests summary. A built-in email client supports SMTP and IMAP, Gmail and other providers, OAuth 2.0, and automatic synchronization, with email campaigns, templates, signatures, and contact segmentation. Additional features listed include web forms with reCAPTCHA v3, Excel import/export, geolocation, VoIP callbacks, and messenger integration, with the interface translated into 23 languages.
use_cases: Self-hosted customer relationship management for a small business
Tracking leads, deals, and sales pipeline
Managing team tasks and projects in one CRM
Running email campaigns and newsletters to contacts
Sending and receiving email linked to customer records
Generating sales funnel and income reports
how_to_run: Clone the repository and follow the Installation & Configuration documentation
Runs as a standard Django project
For testing, SQLite works out of the box with no external database
notable: UI built entirely on Django Admin rather than a separate frontend framework
Email client stores all correspondence in the CRM database and links it to requests, leads, and deals
Optional REST API via third-party Django Admin packages, since no built-in standalone API is provided
caveats: No built-in standalone REST API; one must be added with third-party packages
Requires recent versions: Django 6.0+ and Python 3.12+; older Django 5.2 LTS users are pointed to a separate compatible version
Feature descriptions such as AI assistant and messenger integrations depend on third-party packages and their compatibility
